evidence: Matches the 'Block storage' maintainer label and modifies block storage invariants in 'src/node/blockstorage.cpp'.
rationale: Fixes edge cases and potential assertion failures in block data availability queries. In `CheckBlockDataAvailability`, partial bit matches on `upper_block.nStatus & block_status` could lead to assertion crashes in `GetFirstBlock`, alongside bugs in handling genesis block undo data exemptions.
